title: Understanding Oversmoothing in Diffusion-Based GNNs From the Perspective of Operator Semigroup Theory

problem.claim: The paper studies the oversmoothing issue in diffusion-based graph neural networks.

gap.claim: Prior work established the existence of oversmoothing but did not provide its specific mathematical form.

contributions.claim: The paper develops an operator semigroup theory framework for analyzing oversmoothing beyond random walk and particle-system approaches.
The framework links oversmoothing intrinsically to the ergodicity of the diffusion operator and gives a quantitative form based on ergodicity and the operator's invariant measure.
The paper proposes a general ergodicity-breaking condition for relieving oversmoothing and provides a probabilistic interpretation connecting the theory with prior work.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors distinguish their operator-semigroup perspective and general ergodicity-breaking condition as broader and more universal than prior specific approaches.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments report that the ergodicity-breaking term mitigates oversmoothing as measured by Dirichlet energy.
Experiments report improved performance on node classification tasks when using the ergodicity-breaking term.

narrative_sequence.summary: The paper analyzes oversmoothing in diffusion-based GNNs.
It applies operator semigroup theory to the problem, extending beyond random walk and particle-system analyses.
The analysis connects oversmoothing to diffusion-operator ergodicity and quantitatively characterizes the smoothing feature.
The theory yields a general ergodicity-breaking condition and a probabilistic interpretation.
Reported experiments show reduced Dirichlet-energy oversmoothing and improved node classification performance.

source_observation.claim: Oversmoothing is linked to the ergodicity of the diffusion operator.

interpretation.claim: Analyzing the operator's long-run behavior may provide a principled explanation for oversmoothing.

application.claim: For diffusion-based GNNs, examine ergodicity and invariant measures when diagnosing or mitigating oversmoothing.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish whether this guidance applies beyond diffusion-based GNNs.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify datasets, architectures, baselines, or experimental settings.
The abstract does not provide quantitative result values or details of the ergodicity-breaking term.
